newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil posts $78 mln trade gap to May 25.
newsitem.headline: Brazil posts $78 mln trade gap to May 25.

text.p: Brazil posted a $78 million trade deficit up to May 25, with exports of $3.774 billion and imports of $3.852 billion, a government source said.
The official, asking not to be identified, said average daily exports to May 25 stood at $233.9 million and average daily imports at $240.8 million.
Brazil posted a $951 million trade gap in April, bringing the deficit for the first four months of the year to a whisker under $4.0 billion compared with $5.5 billion for the whole of 1996.
Government officials have said they expected a better result in May because of the continuing soybean harvest and measures to stem imports and boost exports.
